proof_summary: Couple the evolutions from masses differing by one by tracking the extra unit as a marker that stays within two positions of the initial block of unit cells; when the smaller evolution stabilizes, the three possible marker positions show that the larger one stabilizes within two more steps. Conversely, classifying positive predecessors of an all-ones configuration as either already stable or a block of ones ending in a single 2, together with the marker invariant, rules out simultaneous first stabilization, giving a strict delay of at least one step.
